in_marathi.name: Latha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Latha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Latha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lata' which means 'creeping plant' or 'climbing plant'. In Hindu mythology, Latha represents the goddess of love and beauty. The name is also associated with fresh leaves and new beginnings. It is a beautiful and graceful name for a baby girl.
